thread:
maria: quick one 1: seeing duplicate request ids in Node SDK when retry happens. repro steps below.
leo: only for our retry middleware or any retry lib?
maria: both our http-retry and axios-retry in sampleapp. logs show same request_id across attempts, e.g.:
```
18:00:00 INFO request_id=xyz123 start POST /v1/generate
18:00:01 WARN request_id=xyz123 retry
18:00:01 INFO request_id=xyz123 start POST /v1/generate
```
leo: that will break redaction and trace counting.
jordana: which SDK version?
maria: node @1.7.2, node 18. Hypothesis: otel/autoinit hook runs after retry wrapper, so context isn't refreshed on retry.
sara: makes sense. in python we clone context on retry; node uses async_hooks so ordering matters.
alex: quick workaround: have retry middleware inject a new x-request-id on each attempt.
maria: did that locally 1: fixes logs but traces still show original span id.
jordana: proposal: add opt-in LOG_EVENT_ID per log emission (x-log-event-id header or log field) so redaction and dedupe operate on event-level id. i can own feature flag and CHANGELOG.
sara: i'll audit otel hook ordering and make retry create child spans instead of reusing exact span id.
alex: i'll add a tiny CI e2e in sampleapp asserting distinct x-request-id headers when retry occurs.
devex-bot: create ticket DE-1248 for follow-ups.
maria: thanks, will follow up with short postmortem once merged.
